summary_1line: Abhimanyu boldly vows to break Drona’s formation, charges into the array, and begins slaughtering surrounding Kaurava warriors despite warnings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Abhimanyu’s chariot with golden trappings charges alone toward Drona’s vast battle array while armies surge behind him.
The young warrior Abhimanyu, gleaming in golden mail with a Karnikara-bannered chariot, crashes into a ring of elephants, chariots, and soldiers.
Severed crowned heads and jeweled arms lie scattered across the battlefield as Abhimanyu stands amid the carnage shooting arrows in every direction.
